ActivationCode.title: ActivationCode
ActivationCode.description: One-device license activation code stored in Firestore. Checked once during initial app activation and locked permanently to a single device.

code.description: Optional copy of the uppercase activation code.

status.description: License availability status; transitions once from available to used.

usedByBusinessName.description: Business name entered by the merchant during activation.

registeredDeviceId.description: Permanent device identifier bound to this license code.

usedAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when activated.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin generated the license code.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin updated the license code.

createdBy.description: Admin identifier or email who generated the code.

customerName.description: Optional buyer name recorded by admin.

customerEmail.description: Optional buyer email recorded by admin.

notes.description: Optional admin notes for the license code.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered user or merchant account metadata managed by admin and readable/updatable by the owning authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

userId.description: Alias user ID matching the document ID.

isActive.description: Whether the user record is active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

/activation_codes/{code}.description: One-time single-device activation codes verified once online; full CRUD and list access granted to verified admin farahrifa58@gmail.com.

/users/{userId}.description: User records with full CRUD and list access for verified admin farahrifa58@gmail.com and strict owner-only isolation for regular authenticated users.
